name: airplay_receiver
description: AirPlay 2 receiver for ESP32 / ESP32-S3 with a centralized airplay_* allocator enforcing a PSRAM/internal memory policy. Ported: the AirPlay 2 HomeKit pairing + ChaCha20-Poly1305 crypto slice (SRP-6a 3072-bit / Ed25519 / X25519 / ChaCha20-Poly1305) and the AirPlay 2 transport/control layer (_airplay._tcp mDNS advert + RTSP server on 7000 serving ANNOUNCE/SETUP/RECORD/PAIR-SETUP/PAIR-VERIFY/SET/GET_PARAMETER/TEARDOWN/FLUSH, all heap via airplay_*). The audio decode/output pipeline (decoder/timing/audio) remains a skeleton; the transport exposes an event/callback interface for it.

notes: espressif/libsodium is pulled in from the component's __init__.py via add_idf_component(name="espressif/libsodium", ref="1.0.21") (Ed25519/X25519/ChaCha20-Poly1305/SHA-512+HMA + randombytes). mbedtls is a built-in IDF component (SRP bignum + raw-signature AES-CTR).

Ported: main/hap/* (HAP pairing: pair-setup SRP-6a 3072-bit, pair-verify Ed25519+X25519+ChaCha20-Poly1305), main/audio/audio_crypto.c ChaCha20-Poly1305 branch. NOT ported: AirPlay 1 RSA auth (main/rtsp/rtsp_rsa.c), AES-CBC audio encryption, FairPlay handshake (main/rtsp/rtsp_fairplay.c).

memory.target_part: ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N8R8 (8MiB flash, 8MiB octal PSRAM, 512KiB internal SRAM)
memory.policy: realtime -> internal DRAM; non-realtime -> PSRAM-first with AIRPLAY_ALWAYS_INTERNAL_BYTES small-allocation threshold
